lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen and home new_flow, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, despite results consistently leaning positive.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info across 2 tests or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect in one test and caused a significant drop in another, requiring an early stop.
Predictions were frequently overly optimistic for minor tweaks, yet severely underestimated major positive outcomes like the winning adoption redesign.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Stage Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection step into an interactive stage layout centered on personality trait choices.
candidates.why: Adoption step has 70.1% conversion and prior test lessons show adoption redesigns yield statistically significant gains.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before completion detailing pet shortcuts, desktop controls, and speech commands.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, while finish dropoff is 35.2%.

new_interaction_overview.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion
new_interaction_overview.body: Control your pet directly from your desktop screen using hotkeys and menu shortcuts.

guard.reason: Adding an interaction overview screen inside onboarding is allowed and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step (35.2%) with strong support evidence, though single prior test leaves confidence moderate.

candidates.title: Split Layout Photo Customization View
candidates.change: Switch the photo upload screen layout to split view displaying side-by-side companion preview and photo reference guidelines.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports regarding failed custom pet rendering or incorrect visual output during photo customization.

upload_photos.headline: Custom Companion Reference Photo
upload_photos.hint: Ensure bright lighting and clear framing for optimal desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information by requesting a user reference photo.

candidates.title: Hero Path Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path choice screen using prominent interactive hero cards to highlight companion playstyles.
candidates.why: Choose path step shows high mean time (514s), indicating user indecision during initial path selection.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Hatching Mini-Game Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated interactive waiting screen allowing users to engage with pet animations while setup finishes.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to dropoffs due to idle setup waiting.

new_hatching_playground.headline: Companion Hatching Playground
new_hatching_playground.body: Tap to interact with your pet while desktop initialization completes.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive hatching screen after waiting preserves all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Lowest step dropoff and previous home new_flow test produced negative lift (-3.7%).

candidates.title: Account Session Sync Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that account connection preserves pets across app restarts.
candidates.why: Top support issue (8 emails) involves pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in saves your pet cloud progress so pets are not reset when opening the desktop app later.

guard.reason: Adding explanatory sign-in copy about cloud saving is valid and compliant.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses top support issue via simple config text change, though copy tweaks usually have modest impact.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launchpad Stage Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the final welcome screen into a stage layout with immediate desktop pet launch triggers.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with an extreme mean duration of 5815s.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your new companion is initialized and ready to roam your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step and extreme duration; redesigns show potential based on adoption redesign learnings.

candidates.title: Pet Naming and Personality Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after pet selection to build emotional connection early.
candidates.why: Enhancing emotional commitment during adoption directly addresses the 29.9% adoption step dropoff.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_naming.body: Choose a unique name for your pet before final customization.

guard.reason: Adding a pet naming screen inside onboarding is allowed and keeps all base steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 29.9% adoption dropoff, but adding a new screen risks increasing friction.

candidates.title: Starter Companion Perk Badge Preview
candidates.change: Add perk badges to path selection options showcasing starter items included with each companion path.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users abandon onboarding at choose_path; highlight instant rewards to increase path commitment.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, starter items, or free extras.

candidates.title: Centered Direct Sign-In Layout
candidates.change: Reframe sign-in using a centered layout focused on single-click authentication and account safety messaging.
candidates.why: 27.1% of users fail sign_in and support reports app stalling or missing sign-in screens.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to enable cloud saving and guard against companion data loss.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout with security messaging is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses sign-in failure complaints and 27.1% dropoff, but past sign-in tweaks showed minimal impact.

picked: Pet Naming and Personality Showcase Screen

decisions.title: Pet Naming and Personality Showcase Screen

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, and sign_in hint, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, home wait_info across 2 tests, or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect in one test and caused a significant drop in another, requiring an early stop.
Predictions were frequently overly optimistic for minor tweaks, yet severely underestimated major positive outcomes like the winning adoption redesign.
